intent: original production surface atlas; reference environment style only
technicalPreparation: Blender crops four quadrants, linearises PNG byte values into float buffers, resamples each swatch to 1024 and bakes part-local two-band shading/AO to UV atlases. No new image detail is claimed from resampling.
